title: On Windows Chrome the hand pointer has a black outline in Board and Tech View
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in with the "Admin" role at {Location-A}, in a browser window at least 1024 px wide.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • You are on a Windows computer in Chrome, with the standard Windows pointer.
    For example: Windows 11, one 1920 x 1080 screen.
  • {Location-A} has a technician {Technician-A} who leads at least one Approved work order, {Work-order-1}.
    For example: {Technician-A} is Esther Howard.
  • Starting screen: "Work Orders" > "All" tab, "Board View" shown, "Search" empty, no filter chosen.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Point at {Work-order-1}'s card without clicking.
  2. Point at {Technician-A}'s column header.
  3. Start dragging {Work-order-1}'s card and hold it.
  4. Drop it back where it was.
  5. Click "Tech View" and point at {Work-order-1}'s row.
  6. Start dragging the row and hold it.
  7. Drop it back where it was.
  8. Click "List" and point at {Work-order-1}'s row.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the pointer is an open hand, white with a clear black outline, easy to see on the white card.
  • Step 2: the same outlined open hand.
  • Step 3: the pointer is a closed hand with the black outline the whole time you hold the card.
  • Step 4: the card is back in its place.
  • Step 5: the outlined open hand.
  • Step 6: the outlined closed hand the whole time.
  • Step 7: the row is back in its place.
  • Step 8: List's pointer is unchanged from today.

Known problem (SV-11588, Open, fast follow): Chrome on Windows draws its own hands, which on some screens are pure white with no outline and disappear against the white cards. (1) If you see exactly that, mark this test Failed and raise nothing new. (2) If it fails in a different way, report it. (3) If every hand has a black outline, mark it Passed and tell the QA lead: the fix has shipped.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: Jira SV-11588, “Board View and Tech View: hand cursor turns invisible white on Windows; use our own outlined hand” (Chris Ward, product owner, 20 Oct 2026), read 21 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10043, story SV-10052 (Story 9, Drag to reorder work and technician groups/columns)

  • Fix: “Replace the browser's grab and grabbing hands in Board View and Tech View with our own hand cursors: a white hand with a 2px black outline, the same shapes (open hand while hovering, closed hand while dragging), about 32px.”
  • Fix: “Apply it everywhere these views use a hand today: Board View cards and column headers, Tech View rows and group headers, and while dragging in either view.”
  • How to check: “On Windows in Chrome, hover a Board View card, a Tech View row and a technician header: the hand has a clear black outline on white and on blue.”
  • How to check: “Drag a card or row: the closed hand keeps its black outline the whole drag.”
  • How to check: “List and every other page are unchanged.”

Not yet checked against a build.

AUTOMATION: HOLD - the pointer's drawing cannot be captured by browser automation; a person checks it on Windows
